NinjaTrader Guide, Cash Accounts

Assigning Algos and Strategies to Your Cash Account

This walks you through reconnecting your algos in NinjaTrader after the 9.0 updater, loading each one with the exact set file the Cash Allocation Tool gave you, assigning it to the right cash account, then clearing out the old strategies once the new ones are running.

If you wish to see the walkthrough video, you can watch it here. Otherwise, the steps below have you covered. Your progress is saved on this device.

Cash setup at a glance

Three pages, done in order. Complete all of it inside your VPS.

  1. 1Install the updaterDownload, extract, and run the five numbered tools on your VPS.
  2. 2Cash Allocation ToolEnter your account balances and get the exact set file for each algo.
  3. 3Assign algosLoad each set file into its strategy on the right account.You are here
0 of 6 steps complete

Tick each step as you go.

  1. 1

    Log into NinjaTrader

    A minute or two

    Your strategies reconnect to your cash account through NinjaTrader, so it needs to be fully loaded before you start reassigning anything.

    1. Double click the red icon for NinjaTrader to get it going.
    2. Log into your NinjaTrader.
    3. Wait until NinjaTrader is fully loaded before moving to the next step.
    4. Keep the Cash Allocation Tool page open with your Account Recommendations. It lists the exact set file for each algo on each account.
    Walkthrough about 0:00 to 0:19
  2. 2

    Open the strategies list on the chart

    A minute

    This opens the list of strategies available to load onto that chart. As an example, this walkthrough uses MST, but the same steps apply to any algo you are reassigning.

    1. On the actual algo chart, the one with the red and green candles, click right next to those candles rather than directly on them. Clicking on a candle drops a marker dot on the chart.
    2. Right click in that blank area next to the candles and go to Strategies.
    3. Your strategies load into the list on the left under Available.
    4. Find your algo in the list (for example MST-3.3). Yours will be the version without PF in the title.
    Walkthrough about 1:48 to 2:02
  3. 3

    Load the algo and its 9.0 set file

    About 2 minutes per algo

    Double clicking moves the strategy into Configured. Loading the exact set file the allocator named sets the size to match your plan. New in 9.0: set file names. Each algo now has numbered templates in the format NN - ALGO - INSTRUMENT - TIMEFRAME - size:

    • 0 - Default - the default Allocation Set File (for example 0 - Default - MST - YM - 10 Minute - $20,000 Allocation Set File)
    • 01 to 09 - $10,000 to $90,000 Allocation Set File, in $10,000 steps
    • 10 to 13 - $100,000, $150,000, $200,000, $300,000 Allocation Set File (at these sizes some algos switch from the micro to the mini contract, for example URGO uses NQ)
    • 14 to 17 - 100%, 50%, 33%, 25% Split Account Balance - Compounding Model
    • 18 - High Risk - FULL ACCOUNT BALANCE - Compounding Model

    1. Double click your algo in the Available list. It drops down into Configured.
    2. With it selected, click template at the bottom right, then load.
    3. In Load Strategy Template, pick the exact file name from the allocator (for example 0 - Default - MST - YM - 10 Minute - $20,000 Allocation Set File) and click Load.
    4. Check that the Label and Fixed account size ($) now match that set file.
    Walkthrough about 2:02 to 2:21
  4. 4

    Select your cash account, check the license key, and apply

    A minute

    This is what actually turns the algo on for your cash account. The Account field can show up in different spots depending on the strategy, so check both the top and bottom of the panel.

    1. Select the accounts field, which can sometimes be further down in some strategies.
    2. Select the cash account the allocator assigned this algo to.
    3. Confirm the License Key field is filled in (the License Key Tool in the updater stamps it into every set file).
    4. Click Apply, then OK.
    5. Confirm you see that strategy show up in your Strategies tab.
    You'll need to repeat this reassigning process each time there is an updater. Use the exact set file name shown in the allocator. Balances below the listed floors may still trade but carry greater drawdown risk.
    Walkthrough about 2:21 to 2:30
  5. 5

    Repeat for the next algo

    A few minutes

    Each algo gets reassigned on its own chart, so you are not finished after the first one. Each algos tab gets matched up with its corresponding chart, one at a time, until every algo card on every account in the allocator is loaded.

    1. Start this process over from section 2, Open the strategies list on the chart.
    2. Find the next algos tab and its corresponding chart.
    3. Run sections 2 through 4 again for that algo.
    4. Keep matching each algos tab to its corresponding chart until every algo card on every account in the allocator is done.
    Walkthrough about 2:30 to 3:01
  6. 6

    Remove the old strategies

    A minute

    Once the new strategies are reassigned and confirmed, the old ones from before the updater are just clutter and should come out so your Strategies tab only shows what's actually running.

    1. Select the old strategy or strategies you want out.
    2. Right click and choose Remove.

  7. Strategies reassigned

    Your algos are reconnected and assigned to your cash accounts with the 9.0 set files from the allocator, with the old pre-updater strategies removed. If anything looks off, open a support ticket in the Vincere Discord: support, submit-ticket.
